signIn.title: Welcome to LexFlow
signIn.lead: Sign in with your email and password to continue.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.intro: Protect your account by asking for a second factor at every sign-in: a code from an authenticator app or a code sent by email.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.hint: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.

totp.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or another).
totp.qrAlt: QR code to set up the authenticator app
totp.key: Or type this key into the app:

create.title: Create your office
create.lead: You are not part of any office yet. Create yours to get started; you will be the office administrator. If you received an invitation, open the link in the email.
create.name: Office name

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.lead: The person receives an email with the invitation link, valid for 7 days. Anyone without an account creates one from the same link.

organization.title: Office
organization.name: Office name
organization.mfaRequired: Require two-step verification from every member
organization.mfaHint: Members without a second factor lose access to office data until they turn it on and sign in again.

roles.title: Roles
roles.name: Name
roles.adminLocked: The office administrator always has every permission.

customFields.title: Custom fields
customFields.label: Label
customFields.noFields: No fields for this record type.
customFields.testHint: Active fields appear here as they will in the record forms; "Validate" checks the values on the server without saving.

invitation.title: Invitation to {{organization}}
invitation.registerHint: No account yet? Create one with the invited email, confirm the email and sign in: the invitation will still be here.

people.title: People
people.search: Search by name or tax ID
people.name: Name

form.cnpjHint: Type the CNPJ and look it up at the Federal Revenue to fill in.
form.cnpjFilled: Federal Revenue data filled in. Check before saving.
form.name: Full name
form.similar: There are similar records. Check this is not the same person:

detail.anonymizedNote: Record anonymized on {{ date }} (LGPD). Personal data was erased and the record can no longer be changed.
detail.mergeTitle: Merge a duplicate record into this one
detail.mergeHint: This record keeps its own data and receives the missing fields; roles, contacts and addresses are combined. The duplicate is deleted.
detail.noDuplicates: No records similar to this one.
detail.anonymizeWarning: This cannot be undone: name, tax ID, contacts, addresses and office fields are erased.
detail.deleteHint: The record leaves the lists and the tax ID is free for a new record. The history stays in the audit trail.

soon.cases: This person's cases appear here with the cases module (Stage 5).
soon.documents: Documents appear here with document management (Stage 9).
soon.finance: Agreements, invoices and payments appear here with the finance module (Stage 10).

conflicts.title: Conflict of interest
conflicts.intro: Before opening a client or a case, check whether the person already appears on the other side in records, economic groups or cases.
conflicts.name: Name or legal name
conflicts.noHits: No records, groups or cases on the opposite side.
conflicts.justificationHint: Required when there is an alert; kept in the bar compliance report.
conflicts.proceeded: Check completed: go ahead with the client or case.
